sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT] Two hacker groups that breached Russia's Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat) say leaked death-certificate records show 393,881 (Cyber Partisans, strict count of deaths explicitly tied to military operations) to 450,100 (Silent Crow, broader count incl. non-combat military deaths and unspecified-cause deaths) Russians killed in the Ukraine war, Feb 2022-Aug 2026. Bloomberg reviewed the shared dataset: ~392,700 death certificates explicitly link fatalities to the war; metadata consistent with a genuine data export, no indicators of fabrication -- but cryptographic authenticity could not be proven. Rosstat acknowledged targeted cyberattacks Oct 29-Nov 1 but denies its databases were compromised or data leaked. Meduza and Mediazona obtained the material and are examining authenticity/completeness. Context baselines: Mediazona/BBC Russian named-dead database 285,881 as of Nov 6; Meduza/Mediazona inheritance-registry estimate ~350,000 by end-2025. If verified, deadliest Russian conflict since WWII (vs ~13,000-15,000 Soviet dead in Afghanistan).
sections.what_verified: 6 distinct publisher families with declared tiers: Bloomberg T1 (reviewed the dataset), Meduza T2, Kyiv Independent T2, Moscow Times T3, Times of India T3, RFE/RL T3 (STATE US-funded). Attribution-only (NOT counted, no declared tier): Kyiv Post, The Independent (UK), Times Now, Daily Guardian, bne IntelliNews, Straits Times (carrier of Bloomberg reporting -- counts as Bloomberg family, not separate).
sections.what_disputed: Rosstat denies any database compromise or leak (acknowledges only that systems were targeted Oct 29-Nov 1). Authenticity not cryptographically proven (Bloomberg). Meduza/Mediazona still examining; the dataset excludes missing personnel and 27,000 foreign fighters (Moscow Times). Silent Crow's own yearly figures sum to 392,485, below its 450,100 headline -- the published analysis does not reconcile the gap (bne IntelliNews). The 450,100 figure adds an estimated 9,118 deaths with no stated cause in frontline districts -- an extrapolation, not a count. Kyiv Independent: could not immediately verify authenticity or estimates.
sections.why_matters: Russia's own death certificates say up to 450,000 dead -- the number Moscow hid for four years. Claim-bust frame, hard counted number in title, NATO/Russia proven lane. Framing discipline: figures are hacker-group calculations from allegedly leaked data; Bloomberg metadata review + Rosstat denial + Meduza/Mediazona still checking must be in the video; never present 450,100 as confirmed fact.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- Rosstat hack: leaked death records put Russian war dead at 393,881-450,100; Bloomberg reviewed the shared dataset (metadata consistent with genuine export, no fabrication indicators); Rosstat denies any leak

totw_analysis: Our read: Russia's own death certificates say up to 450,000 dead -- the number Moscow hid for four years. Claim-bust frame, hard counted number in title, NATO/Russia proven lane. Framing discipline: figures are hacker-group calculations from allegedly leaked data; Bloomberg metadata review + Rosstat denial + Meduza/Mediazona still checking must be in the video; never present 450,100 as confirmed fact. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Are the hacked numbers real proof of 450,000 dead -- or unverifiable hacktivist propaganda? (Social threads split exactly on this; second fault line: WWII comparisons -- more Russians dead in 4 years than Americans in all of WWII.)
